findings.title: Supplied link tokens are 9 characters, not the 10-character ASIN length
findings.detail: All five path tokens (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) are 9 characters. Non-official references describe ASINs as 10 characters (SRC-10, SRC-11). An official Amazon definition was not located, so the length rule itself is unverified. The tokens therefore cannot be confirmed as ASINs.
findings.impact: No intended ASIN can be recorded for any product. The product-intent confirmation fields are blank.
findings.action: Owner: confirm the ASIN or full listing URL for each product, or confirm what the tokens are.

findings.title: Two short links resolve to a different ASIN than their token
findings.detail: link.amazon/B04G1MEwY lands on /dp/B0CDY277D3 (CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven). link.amazon/B02NbDxp3 lands on /dp/B09B7SB46R (Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven). The destination ASIN is recorded separately as 'observed' and is not treated as intended.
findings.impact: Token and destination disagree. Either the token is not an ASIN, or the link resolves to a different listing than the one the owner meant.
findings.action: Owner: confirm which listing each product should be. Do not merge the two fields until that is confirmed.

findings.title: Three short links did not reach a product page
findings.detail: link.amazon/B00hJ57DV returned HTTP 500 on the first attempt and reached the Amazon homepage on retry. link.amazon/B0c8moW59 returned HTTP 500 first, then an Amazon 'Continue shopping' checkpoint on retry. link.amazon/B0f3GKalj reached the Amazon homepage; a direct /dp/B0f3GKalj fetch failed. No product was observed for P-03, P-04, or P-05. The cause (expired link, geo or session behaviour, or the fetch tool) was not determined.
findings.impact: Three of five products have no verifiable destination.
findings.action: Owner: open each link in a normal browser session and report the final URL, or supply the ASIN. Do not treat these as invalid until tested.

findings.title: Short-link compliance status is unresolved (possible redirecting or badly formatted links)
findings.detail: Program Policies §2(e) disqualifies purchases from a 'Redirecting Link' (one that sends users indirectly through an intermediate site without a customer action). §2(g) disqualifies purchases that are not tracked because links are improperly formatted. Whether the supplied short links fall under either clause is not determined here. This matches the open item FLG-003 in the brief. The links are NOT claimed to be invalid.
findings.impact: Commission may be disqualified if the links are classed as redirecting or badly formatted.
findings.action: Owner: test one link per product in the enrolled Associates account (Special Link workflow), confirm the destination and that the tracking report records the click. Confirm with Associates support if unsure.

findings.title: Associates account, tracking ID, and Special Link test were not possible here
findings.detail: No Associates login or tracking report is available in this session. The tracking ID shopnow047c-20 was accepted as provided and not validated against the account. The Special Link test required by the brief is a manual step.
findings.impact: Clicks cannot be tied to the tracking ID, and link status is unconfirmed.
findings.action: Owner: run the one-link-per-product test and confirm the tracking ID in the Associates account. Record the result on the Flagged for Review page.

findings.title: Referenced source IDs and register are not in the repository
findings.detail: The brief cites S01, S07, S24, SG-27..SG-30, and FLG-003, plus an external 'source register'. None of these exist in the repo. They were not used as sources and could not be mapped to a URL.
findings.action: Owner: add the source register to the repo (or send it) so IDs can be mapped.

findings.title: The 'five defined events' are not defined in the brief
findings.detail: The brief asks for 'the five defined events' but does not list them. The site uses a proposed set (page_view, product_view, outbound_click, guide_view, feed_open) for review.
findings.impact: Click and conversion measurement is not fully specified.
findings.action: Owner: confirm the event list (see Suggestions S-07).

findings.title: Ratings and prices were not reliably attributable to the main product
findings.detail: On the fetched pages, rating and price strings near the top belonged to 'customers also viewed' items (e.g., B0B7C327LK, B0CNSB81V6, B0BYKGN61Q). The main-product rating and price were not captured. Rating counts were also ambiguous to parse (for example '4.41,395'). Both fields are left blank.
findings.impact: No price or review figures appear on the site.
findings.action: Owner or next session: capture price and rating from the main product, with a timestamp, from each confirmed listing.

findings.title: Measurement cannot run on GitHub Pages alone
findings.detail: GitHub Pages serves static files and cannot receive or store events. The click/conversion endpoint required by the brief therefore needs a backend or third-party service. The hook in the site is present but disabled (no endpoint configured).
findings.impact: No click data is being recorded. 'Measure before automating' cannot start yet.
findings.action: Owner: choose an option on the Suggestions page (S-01).

findings.title: Repository contained no prior content to review
findings.detail: At the start of the session the repo held one line of README (`# Affil2`) and no data, site, or coordination file. The 'repo review' was therefore limited to the branch, commit history (one commit), and remote configuration. No other parallel session was detected.
findings.impact: Nothing was found to carry over; the site is built from scratch.

findings.title: Search Console and Associates enrollment need owner accounts
findings.detail: Search Console property verification, sitemap submission, and reader capture (email signup) require accounts this session does not have.
findings.impact: Site is findable by sitemap but not yet submitted to Search Console.
findings.action: Owner: verify the property in Search Console and submit https://karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil2/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Product imagery reuse needs a licence check
findings.detail: The site uses no Amazon product images. Reuse of Amazon content is governed by the Associates Program IP License (inside the Program Policies). That section was not read.
findings.impact: None currently. Blocks adding product photos.
findings.action: Owner: review the Program Policies IP License section before adding images.

findings.title: Search-referred purchases are disqualified under the policy
findings.detail: Program Policies §2(d) disqualifies purchases by a customer who is referred to Amazon through a link generated or displayed on a search engine. The clause is about the route into Amazon. How it applies to a site that is itself found through search, then links out, was not determined.
findings.impact: SEO-driven traffic may or may not produce commissions, depending on the route. This affects the SEO plan.
findings.action: Owner: confirm with Associates support before scaling organic traffic.

findings.title: The Amazon Associates identification statement is shown on every page
findings.detail: The verbatim §5 statement appears in the disclosure strip under the masthead and in the footer of every page. The FTC-style disclosure (SRC-04) is on the same strip.
findings.impact: Compliance display requirement met on the built site.
